sharedSelectionEntries.comment:
OPEN REV73: base 130 points and added Champion Chainsword choice; other equipment changes deferred. LEGIONARIES FLAT SPECIALIST PRESENTATION REV52: Legionary 2-3 retains its existing two compact atomic package choices. Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 now each use two direct required radio groups: a singleton Combat Knife group and one flat nine-option specialist weapon group containing Meltagun, Plasmagun, Flamer, Autocannon, Heavy Bolter, Lascannon, Missile Launcher, Reaper Chaincannon, and Heavy Chain Axe. The former Special Weapon Legionary / Heavy Weapon Legionary / Butcher Legionary routing layer has been removed. Existing shared specialist weapon target IDs and both models' existing weapon-link IDs are preserved; the shared target names now contain only the specialist weapon so Combat Knife exports independently. No points, Chaos Influence, attachments, Replenished Ranks behavior, or unrelated Legionaries mechanics changed.
LOADOUT REV15: fixed five-model presentation compiled for listbuilder clarity. Chaos Champion has a mandatory Chainsword / Power Weapon / Power Fist / Daemon Hammer choice and a mandatory Bolt Pistol / Plasma Pistol choice; the player-facing Bolt Pistol label intentionally shortens the source Champion Bolt Pistol name. Legionary 2-3 share one two-model package choice: 2x Boltgun & Combat Knife or 2x Chainsword & Bolt Pistol. Those package buttons carry hidden semantic child items so one player-facing choice can still represent the separate underlying weapons. Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 each choose Special Weapon Legionary, Heavy Weapon Legionary, or Butcher Legionary. Special Weapon Legionaries retain Combat Knife and choose Meltagun / Plasmagun / Flamer; Heavy Weapon Legionaries retain Combat Knife and choose Autocannon / Heavy Bolter / Lascannon / Missile Launcher / Reaper Chaincannon; Butcher Legionaries retain Combat Knife and carry Heavy Chain Axe. The uncommon source-legal fallback where Legionary 4 or 5 remains a normal Boltgun/Combat Knife model is intentionally not given its own button under the companion-listbuilder presentation policy. Chaos Influence is an optional +10 choice between Khornate Bloodlust, Tzeentian Sorcery, Nurglite Contagion, and Slaaneshi Grace. Replenished Ranks zeroes both the root Legionaries cost and any selected Chaos Influence descendant cost when this unit is the Chaos Apothecary's host.
SHARED LOADOUT PACKAGES REV25: Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 now represent every weapon-plus-Combat-Knife state as one shared meaningful package. Special Weapon Legionaries use Meltagun & Combat Knife / Plasmagun & Combat Knife / Flamer & Combat Knife; Heavy Weapon Legionaries use the equivalent Autocannon / Heavy Bolter / Lascannon / Missile Launcher / Reaper Chaincannon & Combat Knife packages; Butcher Legionaries use Heavy Chain Axe & Combat Knife. Each exact package is shared between Legionary 4 and Legionary 5. Existing weapon selection IDs are retained as link IDs; historical standalone Combat Knife IDs remain hidden and optional. Chaos Champion, Legionary 2-3, Chaos Influence, attachments, points, and all other Legionary mechanics are unchanged.
REV33 / 3.3.5 LEGIONARIES CHAMPION GUN UPDATE: Chaos Champion ranged options are now Champion Boltgun, Champion Bolt Pistol, and Champion Plasma Pistol. Existing Bolt Pistol and Plasma Pistol selection IDs are preserved under their updated Champion names.
REV41 CHAMPION CHAINSWORD FIX: Chaos Champion can now select Chainsword alongside Power Weapon, Power Fist, and Daemon Hammer. No other Legionaries loadout or rules behavior changed.

sharedSelectionEntries.name: ◆ Chaos Terminators (2 or 3)

categoryLinks.name: Counts Toward Other Soft Copy Cost

sharedSelectionEntries.comment:
NOVEMBER 7, 2026, 3.4 HOTFIX — CHAOS TERMINATORS EXPORT: Retained the existing Loadout Options hierarchy, two anonymous compulsory model-specific loadout groups and optional +50-point third model. Removed the ☠️ label prefix from all three existing model names. Split the 12 shared weapon identities BY MODEL (model 1 original, model 2 and 3 cloned), but reused each weapon identity ACROSS THE SAME MODEL’s two independent weapon slots. This allows duplicate identical weapons on one model to aggregate as 2x while keeping the loadout sequence of the first two models distinct in a compact unit-line export. No model entries, model groups, entryLink IDs, selection defaults, unit costs, Cyclone Missiles, or options were added, removed or restructured. Live New Recruit export test pending.
OPEN REV73: 2-3 models, 100-point base plus optional third model at 50, same existing polymorphic loadouts copied for third. All Terminator loadout reworks and Cyclone expansion deferred. LOADOUT REV17: the two-model Chaos Terminator unit is presented as two explicit independent model records because its battlefield roles differ substantially despite the PDF expressing them through overlapping replacement clauses. Each model chooses one of three player-facing roles: Combi-weapon Terminator, Heavy Weapon Terminator, or Assault Terminator. Combi-weapon Terminators select one melee weapon plus one Combi package; the Combi packages use a single visible choice with hidden semantic child items, and Combi-Melta & Combi-Bolter costs +10. Heavy Weapon Terminators select one melee weapon plus Reaper Autocannon or Heavy Flamer. Assault Terminators select two independent melee weapons; choosing Lightning Claw in both lists represents paired Lightning Claws without a separate Lightning Claws option. The two models choose roles and loadouts independently, including both models taking the Heavy Weapon Terminator role. Cyclone Missiles remains a single +20 Paid Wargear choice at unit level because the physical model makes its bearer unambiguous during play.
SHARED WEAPON IDS REV25: every repeated player-facing weapon/loadout in Chaos Terminators now links to one shared selection identity. This covers Chainfist, Power Fist, Power Weapon, Chainsword, Lightning Claw, the four Combi-weapon loadouts, Reaper Autocannon, and Heavy Flamer. All existing per-branch selection IDs are retained as entryLink IDs, so defaults and the builder hierarchy stay unchanged. Combined Combi loadouts are treated as the meaningful export leaf; their historical hidden semantic component groups are retained under the shared target but made optional so they do not auto-select. Lernaean Terminators and other Terminator units are intentionally unchanged.
REV28 PRESENTATION REPLAY: suppressed redundant Melee Weapon, Combi-weapon, and Heavy Weapon headers inside the existing role choices. The healthy production shared-weapon IDs are retained; the abandoned export-aggregation branch is not carried forward.
REV44 FIX: removed the obsolete one-Heavy-Weapon-Terminator restriction. Both Terminator models may now independently select the Heavy Weapon Terminator role.

ARSENAL V33 CURRENT STATE: Generic Chosen (3-5) matches playable CSM REV70. All three initial Chosen and both optional +40-point Chosen can independently choose Shrapnel Boltgun under the existing selected-safe Iron Warriors Legion gate. The four-Boltgun prerequisite applies only to the separate Iron Armoury Legionaries unit, never to Chosen. There is no separate Chosen unit-wide Iron Armoury checkbox. Other weapon packages, purchases, IDs, availability checks, and attachment rules are unchanged. CSM alone owns Counts As: Chosen copy-cost accounting; Sandviches's Chosen remains a separate CSM-only Black Legion tribute.
V31 HISTORICAL: A temporary unit-wide Chosen customisation was introduced and subsequently reverted in V32.
V30 HISTORICAL: Generic Chosen (3–5) is mirrored from playable Chaos Space Marines REV67. Chosen 1–3 are independently configurable, Chosen 4–5 are optional +40 Points each, and the two base-model Combi packages and independent Frag/Krak purchases are preserved. All five model positions offer Shrapnel Boltgun using exactly the playable CSM selection IDs. Each Shrapnel choice is selected-safe hidden unless the roster selects the canonical Iron Warriors Legion option (3242-c851-6318-11cd); an already-selected choice instead raises a corrective error. This gating travels with the portable unit: consumers without the CSM Legion selector cannot normally select Shrapnel. The shared Chosen no longer contains the former Manual Loadout / Sandvich tribute preset branch. Standalone Black Legion-only Sandviches's Chosen remains CSM-local. The CSM-only Counts As: Chosen category is intentionally excluded from this portable root; each consumer owns its own copy-cost accounting. All surviving ordinary Chosen semantic IDs are preserved.
V29 HISTORICAL: the previous shared Chosen contained a mutually exclusive Manual Loadout / Sandvich's Chosen branch and lacked Shrapnel Boltgun. Those now-superseded presentation branches were retired during V30 synchronization.

V46 / GS41 — NOVEMBER 8, 2026 RELEASED 3.4 HOTFIX. Renamed the Warpsmith loadout choice Heavy Daemon Hammer to Heavy Thunder Hammer to match the source PDF; preserved its stable ID, default choice, costs, constraints and the remaining shared unit definitions. Mirrored in CSM REV92.

V45 / GS41 — NOVEMBER 7, 2026, RELEASED 3.4 HOTFIX. Chaos Terminators fixed ONLY by per-model shared equipment identity and removing ☠️ from existing names; the unit’s existing anonymous model loadout groups and optional third model remain unchanged. Mirrored in Chaos Space Marines REV91 and Traitors’ Arsenal V45; no intrinsic cost, size, equipment, defaults or choice logic changed.

V44 / GS41 — NOVEMBER 5, 2026 CSM VEHICLE COMBI-BOLTER DISPLAY SYNC
Renamed Storm Bolter to Combi-Bolter for mirrored Chaos Rhino, Chaos Predator and Chaos Vindicator while retaining original selection IDs, costs, defaults, shared unit tree structure, and unrelated library contents. Baseline V43 from the REV88 Chaos synchronization ZIP.

V41 / GS41 — CSM REV86 SHARED UNIT SYNCHRONIZATION (UNPUBLISHED OPEN REVISION)
Based on V39, not the independent V40 stage (which contained an Unstoppable change deferred to global audit). Synced Warp Talons/Obliterators Daemonic removal, Obliterators 1-or-2 model cost/selection tree, Chaos Dreadnought/Contemptor/Leviathan Duty Eternal display links, Chaos Basilisk 130 points, and three corresponding shared ability labels. All other shared units preserved.
V37 / GS41 — DEFILER OPTIONAL WARGEAR RADIO (UNPUBLISHED)
Synchronized Chaos Defiler final 0-to-1 optional wargear radio with playable CSM REV77; removed artificial (None) and cleared its default. The two +20 items, shared unit ID and all other portable roots remain unchanged.
V36 / GS41 — CSM REV76 CHOSEN LIGHTNING CLAWS SYNC (UNPUBLISHED).
Synchronized the portable Chosen (3-5) Loadout Options subtree from playable CSM REV76. All five Chosen now offer model-role selection between original ranged+melee loadout (retaining the single Lightning Claw in melee) and a single paired Lightning Claws replacement for both original weapons. All existing IDs, costs, defaults, Iron Warriors-specific Shrapnel Boltgun gating, optional fourth/fifth models, and portable ownership semantics are preserved. The Chaos Terminators (2 or 3) root is explicitly unchanged. The other 27 portable roots and all shared dependencies remain unchanged. CSM remains at playable REV76 and consumers are not modified.

V35 / GS41 — CSM 3.4 OPEN REVISION PORTABILITY MIRROR (UNPUBLISHED). Changes: Legionaries base 130 + Champion Chainsword; Chaos Terminators (2 or 3) 100 base + optional third model at 50 with old loadouts; Chaos Leviathan loses Unstoppable. Remaining loadout changes deferred. Consumer catalogues should not be modified until coordinated publication.

REV34 / GS41 — UNIT MARKER EXPORT SPACING (FIGURE SPACE FINAL)
Replaced the two ordinary spaces after the ◆ unit marker with one U+2007 FIGURE SPACE across executable unit names and childName mirrors so imported units preserve the same roster-export spacing as native units. No listbuilding mechanics changed.

V33 / GS41 — UNIT UPGRADE RULE-TEXT CLEANUP
Removed embedded local Rules text from 18 unit upgrade selections. Upgrade selection IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, profile links, Unit Ability labels, loadout logic, and all executable listbuilding mechanics are unchanged. Only the 18 local descriptive rule IDs attached to those upgrades were retired.

V32 / GS41 - CHOSEN IRON ARMOURY CORRECTION
Restored the original per-model Iron Warriors-only Shrapnel Boltgun selection to portable Chosen and removed only the temporary unit-wide customisation and its conversion errors. The shared Chosen now mirrors CSM REV69, retaining the V31 non-Chosen changes and the header cleanup.

PREVIOUS REVISION HISTORY (historical, not current implementation):
V31 / GS41 — CHAOS SPACE MARINES 3.3.8 PORTABLE SYNC
Retargeted the reusable Arsenal to the Chaos Space Marines 3.3.8 source. Added the portable Chosen unit-wide optional Iron Armoury customisation and unit-local conversion validation; reclassified Chaos Helbrute and Chaos Dreadnought as Vehicles; removed 17 redundant single-model loadout wrappers in shared roots. Existing semantics and IDs for all other units, equipment choices, Chosen alternatives and consumer-owned availability remain unchanged.

V30 / GS41 — AUTHORITATIVE CSM CHOSEN SYNCHRONIZATION
Rebuilt only the shared Chosen (3–5) definition from playable CSM REV67, preserving its canonical unit ID, surviving model/equipment IDs, intrinsic costs, and five selected-safe Iron Warriors-only Shrapnel Boltgun options. The faction-specific choices are portable because their availability is gated on the CSM Iron Warriors Legion selection; borrowing Chaos factions without that selector cannot normally select them. The obsolete nested Sandvich tribute branch is retired. Standalone Black Legion-only Sandviches's Chosen remains CSM-local and is not added to the Arsenal. CSM-local Counts As: Chosen accounting is intentionally absent from the library root. The other 27 portable unit definitions, all 32 shared equipment definitions, all shared ability profiles, the catalogue ID, and every remaining structural object are unchanged. No consumer catalogue or CSM player-facing changelog was modified.

V29 AND EARLIER REVISION HISTORY (historical, not current executable state):
V29 / GS41 — CULTISTS INTRINSIC ABILITY UPDATE / CSM 3.3.7
Retargeted Great Traitors’ Arsenal to Game System 41 and Chaos Space Marines 3.3.7. Renamed the portable Cultists ability from Call of Chaos to Heretical Servants in the stable-ID ability profile and portable Cultists link. All 28 portable root IDs, equipment packages and costs remain unchanged. The new Iron Warriors-only selectable Shrapnel Boltgun for playable Chosen is deliberately excluded from generic shared Chosen; this is the single intentionally local source/library Chosen difference. All remaining portable unit trees and shared equipment packages remain executable-equivalent to playable CSM REV63. Preserve historic source-sync records below.

V28 / GS40 — CURRENT SOURCE REFERENCE REFRESH
Updated the present-tense Arsenal provenance from GS37 / playable CSM REV50 to GS40 / verified playable CSM REV60. All 28 portable unit roots were rechecked against REV60 and remain executable-structure identical when internal comments are ignored. Historical V20/V21 source records remain unchanged. No shared payload or consumer-facing mechanics changed.

REV27 / GS40 — DIAMOND EXPORT SPACING
Added exactly one additional literal space after every diamond unit-marker character in catalogue-owned strings. Unit names and childName mirrors therefore remain synchronized. No IDs, targets, costs, LP, constraints, modifiers, associations, loadouts, category ownership, or other executable mechanics changed.

REV26 / GS40 — PRACTICE DESCRIPTION CLEANUP COMPATIBILITY
Retargeted to Game System revision 40 after removal of redundant construction-summary text from the 420 Point Practice description. No catalogue-local executable data changed in this revision: Practice LP visibility, explicit 0-LP attachment-only exceptions where present, Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic, points, IDs, loadouts, associations, and all unit mechanics remain unchanged.

REV25 / GS39 — PRACTICE ZERO-LP MIGRATION
This component now targets Game System revision 39. Every locally owned unit root carrying a positive LP cost receives selected-safe Practice hiding: it is hidden while 420 Point Practice is active only when that unit is not already selected. Explicit 0-LP roots do not exist under the project convention, so no exception tags are required. This shared library owns no local Extra Unit Copy Costs Configuration branch; its consumers own that arithmetic. Points, intrinsic LP costs, IDs, loadouts, associations, category ownership, Quick/Standard/Long arithmetic, and unrelated mechanics are unchanged.

V24 — LEGIONARIES UNIT ABILITY OWNERSHIP FIX
Synchronized the portable generic Legionaries root to CSM REV55 by removing the incorrectly inherited Shrapnel Boltguns and Power Knives profile links. The shared profiles remain available in the library, but generic Legionaries no longer expose them. All portable loadout, points, categories, attachments, constraints, and copy-cost semantics are unchanged.

V23 — LEGIONARIES FLAT SPECIALIST WEAPONS
Synchronized the portable Legionaries root to CSM REV52. Legionary 4 and Legionary 5 now each expose Combat Knife as a separate required singleton radio choice and one flat required nine-weapon specialist list. Shared specialist target IDs and per-model weapon-link IDs are preserved; package names now contain only the specialist weapon. No portable unit mechanics changed.

CURRENT SYSTEM-WIDE CONFIGURATION ORDER / GS41
This library targets Game System revision 41. Configuration presentation follows the shared lane doctrine: provenance warning 5 when applicable; Game Size 10; army identity 20; optional army structure 30; Leader Points 40; faction trackers 50; Extra Unit Copy Costs 80; Updated 90; About 100. Only locally-owned applicable lanes are stored in this file; Game Size, Leader Points, and About are supplied by the Game System. No unit IDs, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment topology, loadout legality, or copy-cost arithmetic were changed by this pass.

CURRENT STATE
Great Traitors' Arsenal V36 is the reusable library for Chaos Space Marines 3.3.8 on Game System revision 41. It contains the 28 mechanically portable generic Chaos Space Marines unit roots plus the shared weapon / loadout dependencies and attachment infrastructure required by those roots. The portable Chosen tree is synchronized to playable Chaos Space Marines REV76, with all other portable trees retaining their previously approved state and stable root IDs preserved; consumer-local accounting and presentation remain owned by the consuming catalogue. Legion-section compilations remain intentionally excluded, including the four Legion Chaos Lords, four Legion Terminator Chaos Lords, Terminator Warsmith, Tyrant Siege Terminators, Iron Circle Automata, Nemesis Claw, Lernaean Terminators, Iron Armoury Legionaries, and Power Knife Legionaries.

The five portable Leader roots that intrinsically cost 1 LP remain Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord, Chaos Sorcerer, Master of Possession, Warpsmith, and Chaos Apothecary. Consumers inherit those costs exactly once and must not add duplicate local LP costs. Portable roots now also carry their current top-level Unit Ability links, with the required shared Unit Ability profiles defined locally in this library. Nested sub-abilities remain intentionally omitted.

AUTHORING & RUNTIME NOTES
Portable roots mirror intrinsic source data from the playable catalogue. Chosen's Iron Warriors-only Shrapnel Boltgun options are portable and remain self-gated by the CSM Legion selector; borrowing consumers without that selector do not normally expose them. Stable root IDs and shared package IDs are preserved. Intrinsic unit semantics live with the shared roots; host catalogues own availability, local presentation wrappers, and consumer-local Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic. The library is not itself a roster-accounting engine. The shadow-corrected Cultists structure is preserved: Cultist Champion, Cultist 2, and Cultist 3-10.

SOURCE SYNC HISTORY
V1: generated from the healthy CSM REV26 portable set.
V2: synchronized Daemon Hammer terminology from CSM REV27.
V3: retargeted to GS20.
V4: rebuilt from the healthy line and synchronized the recovered post-REV27 portable changes through CSM REV30.
V5: corrected the temporary library version-label typo.
V6: synchronized the CSM 3.3.5 Defiler rework.
V7: synchronized corrected Defiler cost and Legionaries Champion ranged choices; retargeted to GS21.
V8: synchronized the Defiler Missile Launcher correction.
V9: synchronized all portable roots touched by CSM REV35, including checkbox and vehicle-presentation cleanup.
V10: synchronized the complete 28-root portable set to CSM REV37. This brings in REV36 Additional Model checkbox changes for Possessed, Havocs, and Warp Talons; REV37 checkbox changes for Chosen and Breacher Siege Squad; and the confirmed visible Cannot attach to anything rules for Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord and Warpsmith. Library comments were consolidated for the live GS21 state.
V11 — CSM REV38 CHOSEN PRESENTATION SYNC
Synchronized the portable Chosen root from Chaos Space Marines 3.3.5 REV38: the redundant preset-selector wrapper header is suppressed and No Preset is renamed Manual Loadout. Stable Chosen root/selection IDs, branch nesting, model loadouts, preset behavior, points, validation, and all unrelated portable roots remain unchanged. GS21 retained.
V12 — CSM REV39 CHAOS TERMINATOR HEAVY WEAPON LIMIT SYNC
Synchronized the portable Chaos Terminators root from playable CSM REV39 and added the shared hidden Heavy Weapon Terminator Role semantic category required by its permissive-corrective one-heavy-role limit. Lernaean Terminators remain Legion-bound and are intentionally not part of the Arsenal library. All other 27 portable unit roots remain unchanged; GS21 retained.
V13 — CSM 3.3.6 / CHAOS VINDICATOR SIEGE SHIELD SYNC
Updated the library baseline to Chaos Space Marines 3.3.6 and Game System revision 23. Synchronized the portable Chaos Vindicator root from playable CSM REV40 so its fixed loadout now includes the missing Siege Shield. Lernaean Terminators are Legion-bound and remain outside the Arsenal library, so the 3.3.6 removal of their Heavy Weapon Terminator cap requires no library change. All other portable roots remain unchanged.
V14 — CSM REV41 LEGIONARIES CHAMPION CHAINSWORD SYNC
Synchronized the portable Legionaries root from playable CSM REV41 so the Chaos Champion melee selector now includes Chainsword alongside Power Weapon, Power Fist, and Daemon Hammer. The existing shared Chainsword target and stable entryLink ID from the playable root are preserved. All other portable roots and library mechanics remain unchanged.
V15 — LEADER POINTS MIGRATION
Retargeted the library to Game System revision 24. Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord, Chaos Sorcerer, Master of Possession, Warpsmith, and Chaos Apothecary are the only five portable shared roots carrying both Leader and Counts Toward Leader Maximum semantics; each now intrinsically costs 1 LP, synchronized from playable Chaos Space Marines REV42. Consumer catalogues inherit those costs through their existing entryLinks and must not add duplicate local LP costs. Legion-section compilations remain intentionally excluded from Arsenal, including the four Legion Chaos Lords, four Legion Terminator Chaos Lords, Terminator Warsmith, and other Legion-only roots. The other 23 portable unit roots receive no LP mechanics. Legacy counted-Leader tags remain unchanged for parallel migration validation. Shared IDs, points, loadouts, attachments, Rare semantics, Additional Copy Cost semantics, Counts As categories, and all unrelated library mechanics remain unchanged.

V16 — LEADER POINTS CLEANUP
Runtime validation passed through multiple Great Traitors consumer catalogues. The five legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum links matched the five shared 1-LP Leader roots exactly and were removed. Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord, Chaos Sorcerer, Master of Possession, Warpsmith, and Chaos Apothecary retain intrinsic 1 LP costs on their shared semantic roots. Consumer catalogues remain locally uncharged, so imported Leaders continue to inherit exactly one LP cost. The other 23 portable shared unit roots receive no LP mechanics. Legion-specific compiled Leaders remain outside this library. No points, loadouts, attachments, category ownership, or other shared-library mechanics changed.

V17 — TERMINATOR / CONTEMPTOR BUGFIX SYNC
Synchronized the playable CSM REV44 fixes into portable shared content. Chaos Terminators no longer carry the obsolete Heavy Weapon Terminator role cap or its hidden counting category. Chaos Contemptor Dreadnought now permits Power Fist & in both weapon selectors. Stable unit, weapon, selector, auxiliary, and profile IDs are preserved.

V18 — UNIT SIZE NAME SYNCHRONIZATION / SEPTEMBER 17
Synchronized portable generic unit-root names with playable Chaos Space Marines REV45: Legionaries (5), Cultists (10), Chaos Terminators (2), Possessed (2 or 3), Chosen (3-5), Breacher Siege Squad (3-5), Raptors (3-5), Chaos Bikers (3), Havocs (2 or 3), Warp Talons (2 or 3), and Obliterators (2). Stable shared root IDs, points, loadouts, Leader Points, attachment semantics, and all other mechanics are unchanged.
V20 — CSM REV47 CURRENT TEMPLATE / UNIT ABILITIES SYNC
Retargeted the Arsenal to Game System revision 37 and synchronized all 28 portable generic roots from playable Chaos Space Marines REV47. The sync includes current unit-row, category-display, Loadout Options, model-header, Leader Attachment, semantic Additional Model naming, Terminator Chaos Sorcerer Lord's  command marker, intrinsic Leader Point, and top-level Unit Ability semantics while preserving stable root/subtree IDs. Added only the shared Unit Ability profiles required by those 28 portable roots. Legion-specific compiled roots remain outside the library, and no consumer-local Extra Unit Copy Cost arithmetic was moved into Arsenal.

V20 CONDITIONAL UNIT ABILITY PRESENTATION CORRECTION: the portable shared roots now mirror the current selectable-profile ownership from playable CSM REV47. Chaos Influence, Chaos Allegiance, Daemonic Jump Pack, Smoke Launchers, Venerable, and Armour Piercing High Explosive Shells appear only when their corresponding selection is chosen. Siege Shield remains root-linked on Chaos Vindicator because it is mandatory fixed equipment. Stable shared root IDs and consumer ownership boundaries are unchanged.

V21 — DIAMOND UNIT MARKERS / ADDITIONAL MODEL CLEANUP
Synchronized the 28 portable shared unit roots to Chaos Space Marines REV50 presentation. Remaining unit-row and linked-unit chevrons now use ◆ , while the nine mirrored optional Additional Model checkboxes use plain unprefixed labels. Stable shared root IDs, shared dependency IDs, Game System revision, categories, costs, constraints, modifiers, attachment semantics, conditional Unit Ability ownership, loadout legality, and all portable mechanics are unchanged.
